description: A thick, heavy envelope of cream-colored paper, folded once and held tight by a dark wax seal. The wax has a faint impression of a sun or a star pressed into the center, though the edges are chipped from being handled. The paper feels stiff, and there is a small, faded smear of something red on the back. It has been kept in a dry place, but the edges are starting to yellow.
role_link_note: One of the festival letters the Postman carries, closed weather-tight with beeswax before it can be handed on.
